entities.summary: Boris Sergeyevich Stechkin was a Russian and Soviet scientist, engineer and inventor. He developed a theory of heat engines and was involved in construction of many Soviet aircraft engines. He was also co-developer of Sikorsky Ilya Muromets and Lebedenko's Tsar Tank. He died in Moscow on 2 April 1969.
